newsitem.title: TURKEY: Fourteen killed in Turkey's Kurd conflict.
newsitem.headline: Fourteen killed in Turkey's Kurd conflict.

text.p: Turkey said it killed 12 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels in fighting in the southeast of the country on Thursday, state-run Anatolian news agency said.
The 12 guerrillas were killed in a dawn operation mounted after they had killed a shepherd and stole livestock late on Wednesday in the remote Siirt province, the agency said.
In a separate incident, PKK rebels killed a member of the pro-state village guard militia in Kaynarca village in Mus province, it said.
More than 26,000 people have died since 1984 in the struggle between the Turkish security forces and the PKK who are fighting for independence or autonomy in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
